Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada

Employment Type: Temporary Full Time

Duration: 8 Months months

Workplace Type: Hybrid

About Our Vancouver Office

Located in the heart of downtown Vancouver, between the Pacific Ocean and the Coast Mountains, Teck’s Corporate Office sits in one of Canada’s most culturally diverse cities.

Surrounded by world-renowned nature and globally inspired cuisine, the office brings together many of Teck’s corporate functions - all working toward Teck’s purpose of providing the essential resources the world relies on.

Application Deadline: We will review applications on a rolling-basis 

Duration: 8 months

Positions Available: 1

Start Date: January 4, 2027

For this exciting position, we are specifically targeting students with backgrounds in Business Technology Management, Information Systems, Business Administration, Communications, business transformation, or related fields. Candidates must be enrolled in a Canadian post-secondary institution for the full duration of the co-op term and plan to return to their studies upon completion for at least one academic term. If you are not currently located near the work location, you must be willing to commute or temporarily relocate for the duration of the term. A valid study permit and studentship letter will be required where applicable.

Ideal candidates will have exposure to Microsoft 365 applications such as SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and Power Platform, along with good communication, customer management, and user support skills. Experience with Microsoft Copilot, AI-enabled workplace tools, knowledge management, change management initiatives, and end-user training would be considered strong assets.

Don’t miss out on this opening to be part of one of Canada’s leading mining companies and join our team!

Why consider Teck Resources Limited for your Co-op Placement? 

At Teck, we offer more than just a job – we provide a comprehensive student experience comprised of relevant, hands-on work, vibrant social activities, extensive networking opportunities, and rich professional development. With captivating projects set against stunning backdrops, a culture of inclusivity and collaboration, and boundless opportunities to learn, grow, and have fun, joining us means embracing a fulfilling and dynamic co-op adventure.

In addition to excellent compensation, Teck co-ops receive a variety of advantages including but not limited to:



- Financial assistance to help with travel costs and co-op fees
- Opportunity to develop technical skills and gain practical experience while applying academic knowledge to real-world mining operations and projects
- Enjoy mentorship and guidance from experienced specialists in their respective fields
- Receive primary consideration for professional positions upon graduation

Key Responsibilities



- Be a courageous safety leader; adhere to and sponsor safety and environmental rules and procedures
- Support adoption and responsible use of Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and emerging AI capabilities
- Engage our Champions network and broader community through Viva Engage, Teams, SharePoint, events, office hours, and other corporate channels
- Cultivate an active community where employees share knowledge, ask questions, explore use cases, and celebrate success
- Coordinate and help be responsible for the mentorship program, including participant communications, resources, session support, feedback, and follow-up
- Build clear, practical content such as training materials, quick-start guides, presentations, videos, social posts, and success stories
- Translate technical concepts into plain language and show how tools can improve collaboration, efficiency, and business processes
- Contribute to change, communications, learning, and engagement plans for new capabilities and service updates
- Monitor Microsoft 365 and AI developments, assess user impact, and help keep guidance and learning assets current
- Gather feedback, identify adoption barriers and high-value scenarios, and help measure engagement, usage, and outcomes
- Review, proofread, and maintain content in line with corporate brand, accessibility, privacy, security, and responsible AI expectations
- Collaborate with business, technology, communications, and learning partners to deliver consistent employee experiences

Qualifications



- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Education, Information Systems, or related program
- Strong writing, editing, presentation, interpersonal, and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt content for diverse audiences
- Experience or interest in employee engagement, community management, organisational change, learning, or technology adoption
- Solid understanding of Microsoft 365; familiarity with tools such as Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Planner, Whiteboard, Clipchamp, and Viva Engage is an asset
- Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio and responsible AI practice
- Ability to learn evolving platforms quickly, test new capabilities, and turn findings into practical guidance
- Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast paced environment
- Comfort working independently and multi-functionally with business and technical collaborators
- Experience creating or editing visual and video content is an asset
- Ability to articulate sophisticated concepts clearly and connect with precision in a technical environment
- Spanish language skills are considered an asset

Why choose a Co-op with Teck? 

At Teck, we offer more than just a job – we provide a comprehensive student experience comprised of relevant, hands-on work, vibrant social activities, extensive networking opportunities, and rich professional development.

With captivating projects set against stunning backdrops, a culture of inclusivity and collaboration, and boundless opportunities to learn, grow, and have fun, joining us means embracing a fulfilling and dynamic co-op adventure.

Pay Range: CAD $4,108 - $5,183 per month

The actual amount offered is determined based on the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and competencies and considers internal equity.

In addition, our Co-ops receive a variety of advantages including:



- Financial assistance to help with travel costs and co-op fees 
- Opportunity to develop technical skills and gain practical experience while applying academic knowledge to real-world mining operations and projects 
- Enjoy mentorship and guidance from experienced specialists in their respective fields 
- Receive primary consideration for professional positions upon graduation 

Apply with us 

Take the next step in your career by applying for the Engagement Specialist Co-op, Power Platform role. We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn’t match every requirement. We value diversity and are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free hiring process. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

Overview

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can build momentum that reaches beyond our business, develop skills for the future, and take ownership of your career with support at every stage. Join a firm where your career can make a difference.

Please note that you are limited to one application during the recruitment period as we ask you to think ahead of what office and service line you are most interested in. This position is for a 4-month intern / co-op term.

Overview 

At KPMG in Canada, our people bring their unique perspectives to Canada’s most important challenges. Here, you can develop your skills alongside experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful work, and build a foundation for your career within one of Canada’s leading professional services firms.

KPMG in Canada is growing a team of AI Builders who work with our business teams to explore how AI can improve the way we work. As an AI Builder Intern/Co-op, you will work alongside experienced builders, engineers, and business professionals to turn emerging AI capabilities into prototypes for real business challenges. You will contribute your own ideas, test your work with users, and share it with teams across the firm, gaining firsthand experience in how a major organization puts AI into practice.

What You Will Do



- Build and test AI agents, automations, demos, and other prototypes using KPMG’s approved tools, with guidance from experienced team members. 
- Work with internal teams to understand their workflows, identify problems, and explore where AI could help. 
- Help define what a prototype should do, test whether it works as intended, and improve it based on feedback. 
- Assist with evaluations, documentation, and integrations with approved tools and data sources. 
- Explore how Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects AI tools to systems and data, and help test MCP-based workflows where appropriate. 
- Create reusable components, build notes, and demonstrations that help other teams learn from your work. 
- Participate in AI Lab activities and share your findings with the broader builder community. 
- Learn how security, privacy, governance, and human oversight shape AI solutions in a regulated enterprise. 

Your work will focus primarily on experimentation and prototyping. You may also support more mature solutions alongside engineering and internal transformation teams.

What You Bring To The Role

We welcome students from engineering, computer science, business, design, data science, and related fields, as well as those who have developed technical skills through independent projects.



- You are enrolled in a post-secondary program and are eligible for an internship or co-op work term. 
- You have built something you can discuss, whether through a personal project, a hackathon, previous employment, volunteer work, or coursework. It could be an app, automation, workflow, AI experiment, or other working prototype. 
- You have a working understanding of AI agents, reusable skills, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
- You enjoy learning new tools and can explain how you approached a problem, tested an idea, and responded to what you learned. 
- You are interested in how people work and how technology can improve a real process. 
- You communicate clearly, collaborate well, and are comfortable asking questions when a problem is unclear. 
- You are curious about agentic AI and thoughtful about its limitations, risks, and appropriate use. 

Experience building with AI development tools, APIs, low-code platforms, or enterprise systems is an asset, but you do not need experience with all of them.

Where And How You’ll Work 

You will be based in KPMG’s AI Lab in Toronto. This is a hybrid role with a strong in-person component. You will be expected to work from the Toronto office three to five days per week, depending on lab activities, team needs, and your projects.

You will work with internal teams across the firm, gaining exposure to business challenges, professional disciplines, and enterprise AI applications that extend beyond the classroom.

What’s In It For You 



- Hands-on experience building and testing AI prototypes for real internal use cases. 
- Direct mentorship from experienced builders, engineers, and business professionals, helping you develop both technical depth and professional judgment. 
- Exposure to complex enterprise workflows and the practical considerations involved in adopting AI responsibly. 
- Opportunities to demonstrate your work, learn from feedback, and contribute reusable ideas and components. 
- Access to approved AI models, frameworks, and tools through KPMG’s secure AI Lab environment. 

How To Apply 

Please submit



- Your resume. 
- One project you’ve built and are proud of (required, please include on your cover letter). Briefly describe what you built, your contribution, and what you learned. The project does not need to use AI. 
- Your GitHub profile (required, please include on either resume or cover letter)
- A link to the project (optional). This could be a demo, video, or write-up.

We’re interested in how you approach a problem and bring an idea to life. If your project is private or cannot be shared, you can still describe it in your application.

What does the recruitment process look like? 

Step 1 Apply. Submit the materials listed above.

Step 2 Interview and practical discussion. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to discuss their project or complete a scoped exercise that shows how they approach a problem. Instructions and expectations will be shared in advance.

Step 3 Hiring decision. Final candidates will be assessed on their skills, potential, collaboration, and approach to responsible AI use.

KPMG Ontario Region Pay Range Information

The expected base salary range for this position is $50,000 to $63,000 and may be eligible for bonus awards. The determination of an applicant’s base salary within this range is based on the individual’s location, skills & competencies, and unique qualifications. In addition, KPMG offers a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards program.

Our Values, The KPMG Way

Integrity, we do what is right | Excellence, we never stop learning and improving | Courage, we think and act boldly | Together, we respect each other and draw strength from our differences | For Better, we do what matters

KPMG in Canada is a proud equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive and barrier-free workplace that allows all of our people to reach their full potential. A diverse workforce is key to our success and we believe in bringing your whole self to work. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply and hope you will choose KPMG in Canada as your employer of choice.

Adjustments and accommodations throughout the recruitment process

At KPMG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive recruitment process where all candidates can be themselves and excel. We aim to provide a positive experience and are prepared to offer adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best. Adjustments (informal requests), such as extra preparation time or the option for micro breaks during interviews, and accommodations (formal requests), such as accessible communication supports or technology aids, are tailored to individual needs and role requirements. You will have an opportunity to request an adjustment or accommodation at any point throughout the recruitment process. If you require support, please contact KPMG’s Employee Relations Service team by calling 1-888-466-4778.

AI Usage

We embrace the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. AI tools may help with organizing applications or surfacing relevant qualifications. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI. Every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are equipped with training that empowers them to use these tools responsibly. AI technologies used in our recruitment process undergo detailed risk assessments, including security and privacy requirements, that align with KPMG’s Trusted AI framework.

We believe technology should empower human judgment, not replace it. It’s one of the many ways we’re delivering on our vision of being a technology-first, people-driven firm.
fit_why: Full-stack and API skills match; AI/RAG and prototyping fit the role well

jd:
Building Healthcare That Remembers

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to.

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 285 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways.

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C at a $1.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.

About The Role

We're on the hunt for driven and scrappy product-minded engineering interns to join our team at an exciting stage of our startup's journey. If you're eager to build products, tackle challenging problems, and see your work reach real users, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact. You'll gain hands-on experience in a dynamic startup environment, working with cutting-edge generative AI and voice/transcription models and technologies.

As part of our engineering team, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to take ideas from zero to one. You'll own meaningful projects, contribute to product decisions, and learn what it takes to build and scale software for healthcare professionals. If you're a self-starter who likes to experiment, figure things out, and ship, you'll fit right in. You'll have plenty of autonomy, with guidance and feedback from the team as you navigate new challenges.

The anticipated dates for this role are January 11th - April 30th.

What You'll Do



- Work closely with our engineering team to build features and products from the ground up. 
- Own a scoped project from initial design through implementation, testing, and deployment, with support from experienced engineers. 
- Explore and apply generative AI and voice/transcription technologies to solve real problems for healthcare professionals. 
- Participate actively in product, design, and development discussions, contributing fresh ideas and perspectives. 
- Learn from healthcare professionals and translate their feedback into thoughtful product improvements. 
- Help develop secure, scalable software that meets our HIPAA compliance and security requirements. 

What We're Looking For



- Pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field
- Strong engineering fundamentals and experience building software through coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions, or previous internships. 
- Strong technical problem-solving skills and comfort working through ambiguity in a fast-moving startup environment. 
- Willingness to wear multiple hats, from understanding user needs and designing features to writing code, testing, and debugging. 
- Curiosity, openness to feedback, and a willingness to learn through rapid iteration and experimentation. 
- Bonus points for experience with React, TypeScript, or Go; building or deploying AI/LLM applications; or working with evaluation frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering. 

Benefits & Perks For Assorties



- 💸 Competitive Compensation – Including salary and employee stock options so you share in our success. 
- 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow. 
- 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive. 
- 🩺 Top-Tier Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first. 
- 🏖 Flexible PTO – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it. 
- 🥗 Meals & Snacks – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas. 
- 💪 Fitness Stipend – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health. 
- 🚆 Commuter Benefits – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier. 
- 👵 401(k) – Build your retirement savings. 

How We Work & What We Value

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide how we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com email address.

Compensation Range: $110K - $125K
fit_why: Full-stack web and AI/RAG work matches; startup intern, strong overlap
